principles: A fix validated once, locally, by the check that motivated it is not evidence of durability; most 'fixed/first/working' claims in this window reversed within hours.

Fix the shared capability at its seam, not per call site: id propagation (13 hops), test isolation (4 runners), act-on-held-state (4 patches in one night), resolve-URL joins (11 sites) all recurred because instances were patched separately.

Search history before minting: joint registry, closure-predicate-at-birth, surgical patterns, consumer probes and the 09-23 narrowed false-close all pre-existed; two operator mints were reverted as duplicates.
A negative result needs a positive control through the same address before it becomes a finding.
'Did not run' must never read as neutral: post-land suite ran=false for 4 weeks, behavioural verification ran:false always, pull-sync logs instead of filing.
The drafter optimises whatever the falsifier measures; falsifiers must capture intent and consumer-side behaviour or verification certifies regressions.
Operator exact-edit success is operator drafting under the substrate's name; measure unassisted reach separately.
Anything not expressed as a shape is outside the data-intent-execution weave; make it a shape or retire it rather than hand-wiring callers.
Operator stopgaps (masks, leases, stopped timers, chat-coordinated windows) are architecture gaps; each must become a data-held control the system reads.
A distributed design implemented node-locally re-creates write != read at every node boundary; any topology change requires re-auditing single-node assumptions.
